posts.title: The Cost of Human Frailty: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Test!
posts.description: In a month full of big stories, perhaps the biggest business story was the fall from grace of Jensen Huang and the consequences for Nvidia, investors, and the rest of the AI trade. The initial story, with its potent mix of personal fallibility and security concerns, related to Jensen’s affair with Alice Huang, who news stories labeled a Chinese spy, though the evidence on the ground is still thin.
